claim: Communist government in Kerala India impose a blackout on August 5 to prevent people from watching the Ram Mandir bhoomi pujan ceremony.
evidence: The daily average on August 5, the day of the claimed black-out, was 56.22 million units. The daily averages on August 3 and 4 were 57.4106 and 57.7176 respectively.
